headline: Public hearing on a tobacco permit transfer at 196 Cabot Street and a hearing request on 30 Bartlett Street, plus noise rule changes.
summary: The meeting covers a tobacco permit transfer hearing for 196 Cabot Street and a request to modify a correction order at 30 Bartlett Street. It also covers a proposed noise rule change on state holidays and the appointment of agents.
items: Hearing on tobacco permit transfer from Cabot Variety to CSS Patel Corporation, 196 Cabot Street (TOB-26-2)
Discussion of noise control regulation amendment recommendations from City Councilor Keith Sonia: prohibit construction on state holidays
Hearing request by Christopher Padgett, 30 Bartlett Street, Unit 1, to modify correction order dated September 23, 2026
Vote to appoint agents of the Beverly Board of Health: Laura Ricci, Joseph Reale, Teresa Kirsch, Lauren Roche, Hayden Fitch, Hannah Laffer, Matthew Woolaver, Laura Nash, Steven Kahn
Review next Board meeting date and time: November 2026
Opioid settlement funds: Purdue Funds update
Director reports on day-to-day operations since the last Board meeting
Board member request for consideration of a topic at the next meeting
